$:set -e
printf '=== CONTRACT CHECK ===\n'; test -f AGENTS.md && head -n 12 AGENTS.md; if test -f README.md; then head -n 40 README.md; else echo 'NO_ROOT_README'; fi
printf '=== CURRENT BRANCH ===\n'; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain
printf '=== GENERATED DOCUMENTS ===\n'; for f in 'Tasks/TasksCompleted/scope-instruction-compact.json' 'Tasks/TasksCompleted/account-custom-instruction-wrapper.json' 'Tasks/TasksCompleted/conversation-analytics-end-of-turn-rule.json'; do if test -f "$f"; then echo "PRESENT $f"; else echo "ABSENT $f"; fi; done
printf '=== ORIGINAL TASKS ===\n'; find Tasks -type f -name 'user-prompt-task-*.json' -print | sort
printf '=== ALL TASK FILES ===\n'; find Tasks -type f -print | sort
outputThat: **Structural boundary:** Part I contains exclusively mandatory SHALL imperatives. Part II contains independently organized SHOULD procedures, concrete examples and descriptive contract facts. Procedures do not grant authority or override imperatives.
